title: Maps from a module of finite presentation into a directed colimit factor through a stage, on a qcqs scheme (Stacks 01BS)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. An $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ is *of finite presentation* if every point of $X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ with an exact sequence $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U\to0$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules (Stacks, Modules, Definition 01BN). Let $I$ be a directed set, $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i})_{i\le i'}$ a system of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over $I$ with a colimit $(\mathcal F,(c_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F)_i)$ in the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $\mathcal G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite presentation. Then the canonical map $\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F_i)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$, $g\mapsto c_i\circ g$ on the $i$-th term, is bijective: every $\mathcal O_X$-linear $h:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ is $c_i\circ g$ for some $i\in I$ and some $\mathcal O_X$-linear $g:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F_i$, and if $c_i\circ g=c_{i'}\circ g'$ then $\varphi_{i''i}\circ g=\varphi_{i''i'}\circ g'$ for some $i''\ge i,i'$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BS (lemma-finite-presentation-quasi-compact-colimit, line 3818; proof via Lemma lemma-hom-finite-presentation-colimit, line 3759, and Sheaves, Lemma 009F); its hypothesis (3) (a cofinal system of finite open coverings with quasi-compact pairwise intersections) holds on a qcqs scheme by finite affine open coverings and Schemes, Lemma 01KO (lemma-characterize-quasi-separated, schemes.tex line 4125)

proof.text: Fix $h:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$. Near each point choose an open $W$ with a presentation $\mathcal O^{\oplus m}\xrightarrow{A}\mathcal O^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{b}\mathcal G\to0$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Write $A(e_\ell)=\sum_r a_{r\ell}e_r$. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-hom-finite-presentation-kernel](2), the tuple $s_r=h(b(e_r))$ satisfies $\sum_r a_{r\ell}s_r=0$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-colimit-finite-linear-system-local-lift] on $W$, with its row coefficients $a_{\ell r}=a_{r\ell}$, to obtain a solution $t_r$ on $V$ at one stage $i$, with $c_i(t_r)=s_r|_V$. The same kernel formula identifies this solution with a section of sheaf Hom, hence a map $g:\mathcal G|_V\to\mathcal F_i|_V$: kernels of module sheaves are sectionwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Since $c_i g$ and $h|_V$ agree on all $b(e_r)$, they agree after precomposing with $b$, and cancellation of this epimorphism gives $c_i g=h|_V$. Thus local lifts cover $X$.

proof.text: Refine that cover by a finite affine cover $(U_a)_{a\in A}$ with quasi-compact pairwise intersections, using [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-scheme-cofinal-finite-coverings]. Restrict the local lifts to obtain $g_a:\mathcal G|_{U_a}\to\mathcal F_{i_a}|_{U_a}$. Choose a common upper bound $i$ and postcompose each $g_a$ with $\varphi_{i i_a}$. The cocone identities preserve $c_i g_a=h|_{U_a}$. This also handles an empty cover by choosing any $i\in I$.

source.place: Tag 01BS (lemma-finite-presentation-quasi-compact-colimit), proof via Tag 0GMV and Sheaves Tag 009F; finite-data local lifting, finite-cover descent, and assembly as detailed in report.md

proof.text: Finite presentation gives finite type directly from the displayed local epimorphisms. Both maps have composite $h$ on their overlap. On each quasi-compact $U_a\cap U_b$, [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-hom-colimit-qc-equality] makes the restrictions of $g_a,g_b$ equal at some stage $k_{ab}\ge i$. Choose one $k$ above $i$ and all the finitely many $k_{ab}$. The transported maps now agree on every overlap. Since $\mathcal Hom(\mathcal G,\mathcal F_k)$ is a sheaf [def-pur-sheaf-hom], they glue to $g:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F_k$. The equalities $c_k g=h$ hold on the cover, so hold globally by the same sheaf property. This proves factorization.

source.place: Tag 01BS (lemma-finite-presentation-quasi-compact-colimit), proof via Tag 0GMV and Sheaves Tag 009F; finite-data local lifting, finite-cover descent, and assembly as detailed in report.md

proof.text: For two maps with equal colimit composites, apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-hom-colimit-qc-equality] with $U=X$ to obtain exactly the required common-stage equality. Finally [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise](1),(2) identifies elements of the directed Hom-set colimit with stage representatives modulo eventual equality. Factorization therefore gives surjectivity of the canonical map, and the common-stage equality gives injectivity; its value on the $i$-th representative is $c_i\circ g$ by the cocone universal property.

lean.statement: theorem hom_directedColimit_of_isFinitePresentation (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (D : I ⥤ X.Modules) (c : Cocone D) (hc : IsColimit c) (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.{u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf) G] : (∀ h : G ⟶ c.pt, ∃ (i : I) (g : G ⟶ D.obj i), g ≫ c.ι.app i = h) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (g : G ⟶ D.obj i) (g' : G ⟶ D.obj j), g ≫ c.ι.app i = g' ≫ c.ι.app j → ∃ (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k) (hjk : j ≤ k), g ≫ D.map (homOfLE hik) = g' ≫ D.map (homOfLE hjk))
